items.title: 5.15 Real fluids viscous fluids hain (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Ideal fluid woh fluid hai jis mein viscosity na ho aur jise dabaya (compress) na ja sake. Aisa fluid haqeeqat mein maujood nahi ho sakta.
Jin fluids mein viscosity hoti hai, woh sab real fluids kehlate hain.
Misalein: kerosene, castor oil (arandi ka tel), shehad waghera.
Ideal aur Real Fluids ka muqabla

Ideal fluid ki koi misal nahi di ja sakti, kyun ke yeh asal duniya mein nahi, sirf theory (nazariye) mein hai. Hamare aas paas ke sab fluids, jaise pani, diesel, petrol aur shehad, real fluids hain. In ki viscosity bhi alag alag hoti hai; maslan shehad pani se zyada viscous (gaarha) hai. Bernoulli's equation kehti hai ke fluid ki speed tab barhti hai jab saath hi us ki potential energy ya us par static pressure kam ho. Viscous fluid ka matlab hai fluid ka gaarhapan, ya woh ragar jo behte waqt fluid ko pesh aati hai. Is liye ideal fluid ko koi mukhalif (opposing) force pesh nahi aati aur us ka flow non-viscous hota hai, jab ke real fluids ka flow viscous hota hai.

items: Ideal fluids incompressible hain: pressure se na un ki density badalti hai na volume. Real fluids ko kuch had tak dabaya ja sakta hai (gases bohat zyada, liquids bohat thora).

Bulk modulus volume ki tabdeeli ke ulta (inversely) depend karta hai. Ideal fluid mein volume ki tabdeeli zero hai, is liye us ka bulk modulus infinite (la-mehdood) hai. Real fluids ka volume badalta hai, is liye un ka bulk modulus finite (mehdood) hai.
Ideal fluids sirf theory mein hain, un par surface tension lagu nahi hoti. Real fluids par surface tension lagu hoti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke real fluids “very much compressible” hain. Yeh gases ke liye sahi hai, lekin liquids bohat kam dabte hain: Table 5.1 mein pani ka bulk modulus 2.2 × 10⁹ N m⁻² hai, yani pani ka volume thora sa badalne ke liye bhi bohat bara pressure chahiye.
Saada alfaaz mein: ideal fluids khayali hain, qudrat mein maujood nahi; real fluids haqeeqat mein maujood hain.
Ideal fluids mein koi viscosity nahi, yani un ki viscosity zero hai; real fluids mein viscosity hoti hai.

blocks.caption: Ideal aur real fluid ka farq
rows: pani, diesel, petrol, shehad, kerosene, castor oil

blocks.prompt: Real fluid, ideal fluid aur superfluid mein kya farq hai, aur in mein se kaun se haqeeqat mein maujood hain?
blocks.explanation: Ideal fluid mein viscosity nahi, woh incompressible hai aur us par surface tension nahi; yeh sirf theory mein hai. Real fluid mein viscosity, kuch compressibility aur surface tension hoti hai; hamare aas paas ke sab fluids real hain. Superfluid (5.16) asal maadda hai, jaise bohat kam temperature par helium-4, jis ki viscosity zero hoti hai. Is liye real fluids aur superfluids maujood hain, ideal fluids nahi.

items: Ideal fluid: viscosity nahi, incompressible (bulk modulus infinite), surface tension nahi, sirf theory.
Real fluid: viscous (shehad pani se zyada), kuch compressible, finite bulk modulus, surface tension: pani, diesel, petrol, shehad, kerosene, castor oil.
